title: AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
source: AWS SOA-C03 exam guide domains + service mentions (Context syllabi)

domains.name: Monitoring, Logging, Analysis, Remediation, and Performance Optimization
Monitoring, Logging, Analysis & Performance
domains.subtitle: Domain 1 — CloudWatch, remediation, performance tuning
domains.quizTopic: Monitoring, Logging, Analysis, Remediation, and Performance Optimization

services.name: Amazon CloudWatch
services.desc: Metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards, and agent-based collection for ops visibility.
examTopics: Custom metrics and log metric filters
services.tip: SysOps loves alarm→automate loops. Know what an alarm can invoke.

services.name: AWS CloudTrail
services.desc: API activity logging for audit and troubleshooting who changed what.
examTopics: Pair with CloudWatch for ops investigations

services.name: Amazon EventBridge
services.desc: Event bus for routing, enrichment, and triggering automated responses.

services.name: AWS Systems Manager
services.desc: Ops hub: Session Manager, Patch Manager, Parameter Store, Automation runbooks.
examTopics: Agent/ops tooling without SSH bastions (Session Manager)
Parameter Store for config/secrets patterns (with Secrets Manager)

services.name: Amazon SNS
services.desc: Pub/sub notifications commonly driven by CloudWatch alarms.

services.name: AWS Lambda
services.desc: Serverless compute for automated remediation and event-driven ops.

services.name: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus
services.desc: Managed Prometheus-compatible monitoring for container/cloud-native metrics.
examTopics: When Prometheus fits vs CloudWatch-native metrics

services.name: Amazon EBS / S3 / EFS / FSx performance
services.desc: Storage performance characteristics operators must tune and troubleshoot.
examTopics: EFS lifecycle; shared storage selection (EFS/FSx/S3 Files)

services.name: Amazon RDS Performance Insights & RDS Proxy
services.desc: Database performance monitoring and connection pooling for operational efficiency.

services.name: Amazon EC2 performance & placement
services.desc: Instance monitoring, networking/storage attachments, placement groups.
examTopics: Remediate compute performance with metrics + tags

callouts.title: Domain 1 mindset
items: Detect (metrics/logs) → decide (alarms/rules) → remediate (SSM/Lambda)
Prefer automation runbooks over manual SSH fixes

services.name: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
services.desc: Scale compute fleets on demand with health checks and policies.

services.name: Elastic Load Balancing (ELB)
services.desc: Distribute traffic; health checks for resilient front doors.

services.name: Amazon Route 53 health checks
services.desc: DNS failover and health-based routing for availability.

services.name: Multi-AZ deployments
services.desc: Fault-tolerant patterns across Availability Zones for compute and data stores.

services.name: Amazon CloudFront & ElastiCache
services.desc: Caching layers that improve scalability and offload origins.

services.name: Amazon RDS / DynamoDB scaling
services.desc: Managed database scaling and capacity modes operators configure.

services.name: AWS Backup
services.desc: Centralized backup policies across AWS resources.
examTopics: S3/FSx versioning as part of recovery

services.name: Disaster recovery strategies
services.desc: Backup/restore, pilot light, warm standby, active/active — cost vs RTO/RPO.

domains.name: Deployment, Provisioning, and Automation
domains.subtitle: Domain 3 — IaC, images, StackSets, event-driven ops

services.name: AWS CloudFormation & AWS CDK
services.desc: Infrastructure as code for repeatable provisioning and drift-aware stacks.
examTopics: CDK as IaC authoring layer over CloudFormation

services.name: EC2 Image Builder
services.desc: Automate AMI and container image pipelines with tests and distribution.

services.name: AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM)
services.desc: Share resources across accounts safely.

services.name: Deployment strategies
services.desc: Rolling, blue/green, canary-style operational deployments.

services.name: Event-driven automation
services.desc: S3 Event Notifications, EventBridge, Lambda, DevOps Agent patterns for ops.

services.name: Terraform / Git (third-party)
services.desc: External IaC and VCS workflows operators may use alongside AWS-native tools.
examTopics: Recognize third-party automation in exam scenarios

callouts.title: Provisioning traps
items: Subnet CIDR too small for scale-out
Missing IAM permissions on deployment roles
Manual console drift vs IaC source of truth

services.name: IAM (policies, MFA, federation, roles)
services.desc: Identity foundation: password policies, MFA, roles, resource policies, conditions.
examTopics: Troubleshoot access with Access Analyzer & policy simulator

services.name: AWS Organizations & IAM Identity Center
services.desc: Multi-account governance with SCPs and centralized workforce access.
examTopics: Identity Center for SSO into accounts

services.name: AWS Config
services.desc: Configuration recording, rules, and conformance packs for continuous compliance.

services.name: AWS KMS & ACM
services.desc: Encryption at rest (KMS) and in transit certificates (ACM).

services.name: AWS Security Hub / GuardDuty / Inspector / Trusted Advisor
services.desc: Findings and checks operators triage and remediate.

services.name: CloudTrail (audit access)
services.desc: Investigate access issues and unauthorized API use.
examTopics: Correlate denied calls and actor identity

services.name: Amazon VPC
services.desc: Subnets, route tables, NACLs, security groups, IGW/NAT/egress-only gateways.
services.tip: Draw the path: source SG → route table → NACL → gateway/endpoint.

services.name: AWS PrivateLink & VPC endpoints
services.desc: Private service connectivity without public IPs.

services.name: AWS WAF / Shield / Network Firewall / DNS Firewall
services.desc: Edge and network protection controls operators audit and configure.
examTopics: Where each control sits in the path

services.name: Amazon Route 53
services.desc: DNS hosting, routing policies, Resolver, and query logging.

services.name: Amazon CloudFront & Global Accelerator
services.desc: Content and traffic distribution with caching and anycast acceleration.

services.name: VPC Flow Logs & ELB access logs
services.desc: Primary evidence for connectivity and load balancer troubleshooting.

services.name: Transit Gateway & hybrid connectivity
services.desc: Hub-and-spoke networking and hybrid link troubleshooting themes.

callouts.title: Networking debug order
items: Security group → NACL → route table → gateway/endpoint
Confirm DNS resolution before blaming the app
Use flow logs + load balancer logs together

strategy.title: Think like an operator
items: What metric/log detects the issue?
What alarm/event triggers response?
What automation remediates safely?
How do you verify recovery (RTO/RPO, health checks)?

strategy.title: Common SysOps traps
items: Fixing symptoms in the console instead of IaC/automation
Confusing SG (stateful) vs NACL (stateless)
Ignoring Multi-AZ / health checks in HA questions
Backup without tested restore / unclear RTO-RPO

strategy.title: Study emphasis
items: Monitoring + remediation loops (Domain 1)
VPC + DNS + CDN troubleshooting (Domain 5)
IAM / Organizations / Config / KMS (Domain 4)
ASG/ELB/Backup/DR (Domain 2) and CloudFormation/SSM (Domain 3)

checklist.text: Configure CloudWatch agent, alarms, and dashboards (incl. composite)
Wire alarm → SNS / EventBridge / Lambda / SSM Automation
Use CloudTrail in an access or change investigation
Tune EBS/S3/EFS/RDS performance from metrics
Configure ASG scaling with ELB health checks
Set Route 53 health checks and failover routing
Implement Multi-AZ for applicable data stores
Automate backups with AWS Backup and test restore (RTO/RPO)
Map DR patterns: backup/restore, pilot light, warm standby, active/active
Build/troubleshoot CloudFormation stacks and StackSets
Produce AMIs/images with EC2 Image Builder
Share resources cross-account with RAM
Run SSM Automation for operational tasks
Apply IAM MFA, roles, and policy condition troubleshooting
Use Organizations SCPs + IAM Identity Center patterns
Enforce Config rules / conformance packs
Configure KMS encryption and ACM certificates
Triage Security Hub / GuardDuty / Inspector / Trusted Advisor findings
Troubleshoot VPC SG/NACL/route/NAT paths
Configure VPC endpoints / PrivateLink / peering correctly
Use Route 53 routing policies and Resolver logging
Debug CloudFront caching and distribution issues
Read VPC Flow Logs and ELB access logs to isolate failures
Audit WAF / Shield / Network Firewall placement
Optimize network cost (NAT, data transfer, endpoints)

phases.title: Observe & remediate
phases.focus: Domain 1 monitoring/logging plus Domain 2 HA/backup foundations

phases.title: Network mastery
phases.focus: Domain 5 VPC, DNS, CDN, and log-driven troubleshooting drills

phases.title: Integrated ops scenarios
phases.focus: Cross-domain scenarios: alarm→fixbook, failed deploy, hybrid connectivity, DR restore
